title: Church Leadership
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Church leadership is the Christ-appointed responsibility of qualified servants to shepherd, teach, guard, lead, and care for the people of God. Leaders serve under Christ and are accountable to Him.
summary: Church leadership is the Christ-appointed responsibility of qualified servants to shepherd, teach, guard, lead, and care for the people of God. Leaders serve under Christ and are accountable to Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Chief Shepherd and true Head of the church. All church leadership is delegated, limited, and accountable to Him, never a replacement for His authority.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God appoints leaders in the church for the care and strengthening of His people. Elders, overseers, pastors, teachers, and deacons serve in different ways, but all leadership must honor Christ and His Word.

Church leaders must be spiritually qualified. Scripture emphasizes character, sound doctrine, humility, faithfulness, self-control, and ability to care for the flock.

Leadership is service, not domination. Shepherds are commanded not to lord authority over the flock, but to be examples and to serve under the Chief Shepherd.

Leaders must guard the church from false teaching and care for souls. Their authority is real but not absolute. They lead under Scripture, for the good of the people, and before the face of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Leadership can deeply bless or deeply harm a church. Unqualified, proud, controlling, or careless leaders can damage souls, while faithful shepherds help people grow in truth and safety.

This doctrine helps both leaders and members. Leaders must tremble before Christ, and members should honor faithful leadership without giving any leader the place that belongs only to Jesus.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for faithful church leaders and evaluate leadership by Scripture, not charisma alone. If you lead, serve humbly under Christ, guard your character, teach truth, and care for souls. If you are led, honor what is faithful while remembering that Christ is the final Head of the church.
